lesson: The host-plus-foreign assumption was too strong. El Salvador had one of the largest confirmed deployments and should not have been displaced by China's later pledge, while Peru illustrates that less-publicized regional teams can become operational partners. For joint-rescue questions, retain foreign-foreign combinations and weight confirmed personnel on scene over geopolitical prominence.

Antonelli's season dominance was over-weighted relative to the near-tie in first practice, where Russell was only 0.040 seconds behind. When teammates are separated by hundredths in the same leading car, the event-specific signal should produce a much flatter split; Russell subsequently led final practice and took pole.

The generic drop-zone slate missed Tomblaine, the municipality adjoining Nancy's aviation infrastructure. For sparse aviation-location questions, map airports and activity sites to their exact administrative communes and include secondary urban airfields, rather than forecasting only the best-known skydiving centres.
